browserAfter.readFailureRetry: Loaded admin selection -> synthetic Event.list rejection -> selection/actions disabled -> refresh retry -> exact selection retained.

validation.assertionIntegrity: No regression assertion skipped or removed. Existing inferred-alias samples were changed to explicitly verified aliases to match the stricter identity contract; new negative tests reject text/time-only merging. Date/zone/route/state preservation assertions remain. Unique rows omit unnecessary false ambiguity metadata; preservation deep-equality assertions were not loosened.

collapsePolicy.publicViews: Only exact provider identity or explicitly verified provider aliases, subject to compatible occurrence/venue/session/inventory metadata. Original local route references retained.
collapsePolicy.retained: Providerless same-context pair/triple, recurring dates, distinct sessions, separately owned inventory, sparse metadata; uncertainty is shown without inventing distinct performances.
collapsePolicy.admin: Every original target record remains selectable; no operational retargeting via display deduplication.

metadataReadSummary.provenance: Targeted read-only metadata inspection performed by root agent and supplied to this agent; no production query or mutation performed by this fixture.

sharedKnockedContext.relationship: No verified alias or distinct-performance evidence; retain original records.

metadataReadSummary.hailSunAndDiamondbacksPirates: Two Hail the Sun records and three Diamondbacks/Pirates records lack provider IDs/URLs and confirmed venue timezone/local-time/session context in the inspected metadata. Exact record IDs were not included in the summary supplied to this agent.

boundedListingRead.scope: Bounded public Listing read for the seven inspected IDs only; no private participant fields queried.
boundedListingRead.limitation: Does not prove universal zero inventory, equivalent event identity, or absence of hidden, inaccessible, differently linked or future inventory.

limitations: No production posting, release, merge, deletion or deployment.
